reader.requirement: At --std 85 a detail report group is processed when a GENERATE naming it executes (each execution, after any control break processing) and by no other statement; a GENERATE report-name processes the sole detail without presenting it.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.GroupIndicateConsumedByIssuedGenerate (2002+): whether a detail that did not present consumes its GROUP INDICATE occasion; not whether the detail is processed
DialectLevel < 2002: GENERATE report-name refused when the report has more than one detail (§1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6)
bakes Edition = DialectLevel into the CobolReport that the DialectBehaviors questions read

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectLevel|IsActive in ReportWriterBinder.cs, ReportWriterEmitter.cs, ReportWriter.cs
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f29_04 covers one U-DE line per GENERATE, a suppressed detail and a GENERATE report-name; several reports with their own details, and a GENERATE report-name that is the first GENERATE, are exercised by probe ptype1

probes.printed: stdout INITIATED, U-RH1, U-PH1 1, U-CHF1, U-PF1 1, U-PH1 2, R2 SUMMARY, U-RH2, U-D2, R2 DETAIL, U-D2, TERMINATE, U-PF1 2, U-RF1; file 1 page 1: PH 1 on L1, DE 1-3 on L3-5, PF 1 on L9; page 2: no PH, DE 4-5 on L3-4, PF 2 on L9, RF on L10; file 2: RH2 L2, PH2 L3, DE2 L4, PF2 L8, RF2 L9; file 3 empty and U-RH3 never runs
probes.expected: RH1 suppressed although it has NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE: no page advance, PH first at HEADING; nonprintable CH FINAL runs its USE only; suppressed PH on page 2; GENERATE report-name as the first GENERATE processes the RH and the detail's USE but prints no detail (§1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR1); TERMINATE with no GENERATE processes no RH

probes.printed: COBOL0899 GENERATE R2: the report-name form requires a CONTROL clause; COBOL0899 TYPE CH FINAL not an operand of the CONTROL clause

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR5  the text is in GR5 (quoted: "processed by the report writer control system when a corresponding GENERATE statement is executed")
OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR1  the text is in GR1 (quoted: "no detail report group is presented")

reader.notes: GenerateCore ends with PresentBody(detail) for GENERATE data-name and BeginGroup(detail, print: false) for GENERATE report-name, so the detail's USE runs (U-D2 in ptype1) and nothing prints; no other entry point presents a detail. The edition switches on this path govern GROUP INDICATE bookkeeping and a compile-time count, not the processing this rule states.

refuter.evidence: rtype2-003: three details in one report; each GENERATE processed only its named detail. GENERATE D0 (a nonprintable detail) ran U-D0 with LC unchanged (5 stays 5, 6 stays 6) and printed nothing; D1 and D9 printed on their own lines. rtype1/rtype2: the detail's USE ran before the page advance that its fit test caused (U-D1 4 then U-PF1 then U-PH1), as GR11b/GR12 order it. rnodet-002: GENERATE report-name on a report with no detail (SR6 allows it) compiled and ran, and its CF SUM printed 010 and 005. rtwo-001: GENERATE report-name with two details gave COBOL6823 (§1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6). cite: OK §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR5 'processed by the report writer control system when a corresponding GENERATE statement is executed'; OK §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR2b 'Not more than one detail report group'.
